name: Backflip
text: Return an ally you control to its owner's hand to add 3 to the attack value of another unit for the remainder of the turn.

name: Dark Reflection
text:
Slay 2: [[side]] - [[exhaust]]: Deal 2 damage to a target unit an opponent controls.

* War Within: When this unit is destroyed, exhaust one die in your active pool. If you cannot, place 2 wound tokens on your Phoenixborn.

name: From Darkness
text: You may play this spell after an opponent declares attackers. Deal damage to a target attacking unit equal to the attack value of an exhausted unit you control.

name: Gate's Defender
text:
~ Hidden: After an opponent has declared attackers, you may play this unit from your hand without paying its main action cost.

Alert: Do not place exhaustion tokens on this unit as a result of its countering.

name: Inkspill
text: You may play this spell after you declare attackers. Place 1 exhaustion token on up to 2 target units with an attack value of 1 or less.

name: Juggle
text: Raise 3 dice in your active pool one level. Lower 3 dice in a target opponent's active pool one level. Deal 3 damage to a target unit that opponent controls.

name: Magnificence
text: Re-roll up to 4 dice in a target player's active pool. Swap a target unit's printed attack value with its printed life value for the remainder of the turn. Deal 1 damage to a target unit an opponent controls. Then, deal 1 damage to a target unit an opponent controls.

name: Scrawler
text: Tag 1: When this unit comes into play, place 1 exhaustion token on a target unexhausted unit with an attack value less than the number of Scrawlers you control.

name: Seek the Depths
text: Place a [[Soul Delver]] conjuration onto your battlefield and place 1 status token on your Phoenixborn. Then, shuffle this card into your draw pile.

name: Shade Prowler
text:
Predator 3: When this unit is declared as an attacker, you may deal 3 damage to a target unit an opponent controls with an attack value less than this unit's attack value.

* Fade: Destroy this unit at the end of this round.

name: Shroud
text: After a conjuration you control comes into play, you may place 1 exhaustion token on this spell. If you do, that unit cannot be targeted by attacks, spells, abilities, or dice powers an opponent controls until the start of your next turn or the next round.

name: Soul Delver
text:
Magic Current X: When this unit is declared as an attacker, raise or lower X dice in a target player's active pool one level.

* X = the number of status tokens on your Phoenixborn.

name: Summon Scrawler
text: [[main]] - [[exhaust]] - 1 [[basic]]: Place a [[Scrawler]] conjuration onto your battlefield.

name: Summon Shade Prowler
text: [[main]] - [[exhaust]] - 1 [[illusion:class]] - 1 [[basic]]: Place a [[Shade Prowler]] conjuration onto your battlefield.

name: Summon Whisperer
text:
[[main]] - [[exhaust]] - 1 [[illusion:class]]: Place a [[Whisperer]] conjuration onto your battlefield.

Focus 2: Then, you may lower 1 power die in a target opponent's active pool one level.

name: Umbral Acrobat
text:
Unit Guard: This unit may guard a unit that is being attacked.

Invert: When this unit is declared as an attacker, blocker, or guard, you may swap a target unit's printed attack value with its printed life value for the remainder of the turn.

name: Whisperer
text: * Haunt 1: When this unit is destroyed, lower 1 power die in a target opponent's active pool one level. If you cannot, deal 1 damage to their target Phoenixborn.
